pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: The dark contiguous regions consist of irregular polygonal shapes. Edge gradients are smooth rather than sharp, likely due to image resolution. Individual patches on the lateral flank are larger in spatial area compared to the smaller, more densely packed regions on the posterior.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of light-colored negative space. Pathways are narrow, maintaining a relatively consistent pixel thickness across the flank. Junction nodes where multiple pathways meet are clearly defined and frequent.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A dark, low-amplitude serrated silhouette is visible along the dorsal ridge from the shoulder to the mid-back. The frequency of the jagged peaks is high and regular against the lighter background.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent, high-contrast dark vertical linear feature is visible on the upper mid-flank. This anomaly is characterized by a localized concentration of extremely low-value pixels, distinct from the surrounding patch morphology.
